versions.subject: Queries from Splunk Conf presentation
versions.detection: ( index=carbonblack netconn ) OR ( index=bro ja3 ) | eval ja3_lookup = ja3+":"+ja3s, dst_server = coalesce(server_name, dest_ip) | search NOT [| inputlookup "ja3-ja3s_dict.csv" | fields ja3_lookup | format] | eval remote_ip = coalesce('id.resp_h', dest_ip, remote_ip, "null") | stats values(md5) as md5 values(ja3_lookup) as ja3_lookup values(process_path) as process_path values(dst_server) as dst_server by remote_ip | mvexpand md5 | stats values(remote_ip) as remote_ip values(md5) as md5 values(dst_server) as dst_server by ja3_lookup | lookup md5_to_process_path md5 OUTPUTNEW process_path as process_path | rex field=process_path "(?P<application>[^\\\^\\/]+)$" | search NOT (md5="") AND ja3_lookup=* NOT (remote_ip=10.0.0.0/8 OR remote_ip=172.16.0.0/12 OR remote_ip=192.168.0.0/16) | stats values(dst_server) as dst_server values(md5) as md5 values(application) as application values(remote_ip) as remote_ip by ja3_lookup
